name: bookweave
description: BookWeave publishing platform (React + Vite client and Express + MongoDB server)

scripts.install:all: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install --include=dev && npm --prefix client run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('dist',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.cpSync('client/dist','dist',{recursive:true});"
